name: dna
description: Business rules and domain model your coding agent queries instead of guessing — entities, transitions, validation, and who can approve.

DNA_ORG.title: Organization id
DNA_ORG.description: Workspace / sandbox org id from `npx @dna-codes/cli register` (or dna init). Substituted into the MCP URL.

DNA_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Access token
DNA_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Bearer from `npx @dna-codes/cli register` (sandbox) or a token for the claimed Workspace. Same credential the CLI writes as DNA_ACCESS_TOKEN.
